ssml.notes: Calm-only cues use prosody rate=-15%. Shared (both-mode) cues use -10%. Hard-only cues use the model's default rate. Emotion styles are not applied on simba-3.5. Savage-mode cues use a slightly faster, louder punchline on the last sentence. finish_ohyeah uses a custom celebratory SSML contour.
ssml.finish_ohyeah: SSML: Ohhhhh yeahhhhh! at rate=-25% pitch=+4% volume=+4dB, 300ms break, then You did it! at rate=+5% volume=+3dB. Pitch was reduced from +10% so this naturally low British voice stayed booming instead of thinning out.

audio.loudness: ffmpeg loudnorm I=-16 TP=-1.5 LRA=11; leading/trailing silence only (reverse-trim so mid-sentence pauses are kept), short pad left at each end

clips.text: Thirty seconds left.
Breathe out slowly. Let the exhale be longer than the inhale.
Unclench your hands. Let them float.
Stay with your breath. In, and a long way out.
Notice the urge to rush. Let it pass.
Relax your face and jaw.
Steady breathing. You are in control.
Let your shoulders sink.
The cold is strong. So are you.
You chose this. Own every second.
The cold is talking. You do not have to listen.
Your mind quits long before your body does.
Nobody is coming to pull you out. Stay in.
Slow breath. You are tougher than this water.
This is where most people get out. Not you.
Comfort is the enemy. Sit in it.
Every second in here counts. Keep stacking them.
Time. Step out slowly, and let your body warm up on its own.
Time. You did what most people will not. Step out slowly, and warm up on your own.
Thirty seconds added.
Welcome to the heat. Find a comfortable seat, and close your eyes if you like. Let your breathing slow down.
Into the heat. Sit tall. Slow breath. You are not leaving early.
Breathe in through the nose for four. And out slowly, for six.
Halfway. Check in with your body.

clips.text: One minute left. Enjoy the last of the heat.
Let your forehead soften.
Drop your shoulders away from your ears.
Let your hands rest open and heavy.
Feel the warmth settle into your back.
Unclench your jaw. Let your tongue rest.
Let your legs grow heavy on the bench.
Notice your heartbeat. There is nothing to change.
With each breath out, let go of a little more.
Let your thoughts drift past like steam.
If you feel lightheaded, step out and cool down. That is always fine.
Heat is just pressure. Breathe through it.
Stay still. Stay calm. Stay in.
This is where you get harder.
Quiet the mind. The body follows.
You are not here to be comfortable.
Steady breath. Nothing gets to you.
Lock in. One minute at a time.
If you feel dizzy, get out. Tough is smart, not reckless.
Time. Sit up slowly, and take a moment before you stand. Drink some water.
Time. You earned that. Sit up slowly before you stand, and drink some water.

clips.text: You already started making excuses. I can hear them from here.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (0)

clips.text: That little voice saying get out? That's the weakest part of you. Shut it down.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (1)

clips.text: You last longer in a warm bed than you do in this water. Stay in.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (2)

clips.text: The second it got cold, you started shopping for a reason to bail.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (3)

clips.text: Don't you dare look at that timer like it's going to save you.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (4)

clips.text: Your mind is begging. Your body is fine. Quit listening to the beggar.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (5)

clips.text: Every excuse you have is a lie you tell so you can stay soft.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (6)

clips.text: You quit in your head a minute ago. Get back here and earn this.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (7)

clips.text: That's not the cold running the show. That's weakness looking for a door.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (8)

clips.text: If you get out now, you'll replay this for the rest of the day. Sit.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (9)

clips.text: You said you wanted extreme. Then stop flinching like this is optional.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (10)

clips.text: Soft people leave. You're still in. Don't you blow it now.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (11)

clips.text: Nobody cares about your almost. Stay in and finish, damn it.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (12)

clips.text: You treat a little cold like it's a tragedy. It's water. Handle it.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (13)

clips.text: Hell of a time to get fragile. Get your head back in this.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (14)

clips.text: You didn't come here to negotiate with a tub of water. Stay.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (15)

clips.text: Most people would already be out. You were halfway there yourself.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (16)

clips.text: Comfort is your default. That's why this feels like death. It isn't.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (17)

clips.text: Stop counting seconds like a hostage. Breathe, and take it.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (18)

clips.text: You are not in danger. You are in discomfort. There is a damn difference.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (19)

clips.text: The part of you that wants out has been running your life. Not today.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (20)

clips.text: You fold the second it's unpleasant, then wonder why nothing changes.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (21)

clips.text: This is the easy pain, the kind you chose. Act like it.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (22)

clips.text: Stay in. If your hands go dead or you feel faint, get out. Otherwise, stop being soft.
cues: Savage mode cold/plunge cue, about every 30 seconds (23)

clips.text: You wanted the heat until the heat showed up. Now you're shrinking.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (0)

clips.text: Sitting still is too much for you? That's embarrassing. Stay.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (1)

clips.text: You're already bargaining. No deals. You sit until it's done.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (2)

clips.text: The heat isn't killing you. Your excuses are just getting louder.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (3)

clips.text: Don't slouch your way out of this. Sit tall and take the pressure.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (4)

clips.text: You call this hard? This is a bench and some air. Hold your ground.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (5)

clips.text: Every time it spikes, you look for an exit. That habit is the problem.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (6)

clips.text: You can stay, or you can be the same soft version of you that walked in.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (7)

clips.text: Hell of a performance, giving up in your head while your body is still fine.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (8)

clips.text: Stop fanning yourself with excuses. Breathe, and stay in the fire.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (9)

clips.text: You don't get stronger by waiting for it to feel nice. It won't.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (10)

clips.text: That itch to stand up is weakness standing at the door. Do not open it.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (11)

clips.text: You asked for this. Now you're acting like someone dragged you in.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (12)

clips.text: If you leave early, you didn't almost do it. You quit. Sit.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (13)

clips.text: Sweat isn't an emergency. Quit treating it like one.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (14)

clips.text: Your mind is already outside. Drag it back in, damn it.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (15)

clips.text: This is where you find out if you meant a single word you said.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (16)

clips.text: Average people leave when it gets thick. Decide if that's you.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (17)

clips.text: You are not here to be comfortable. Comfort already owns enough of your day.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (18)

clips.text: Lock in. The heat will pass. Your regret if you bail will not.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (19)

clips.text: Stop shifting around like that's going to save you. Be still.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (20)

clips.text: You break promises to yourself in rooms like this. Not this time.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (21)

clips.text: Take the heat. That's the job. Stop looking for a softer job.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (22)

clips.text: If you feel dizzy or sick, get out and cool down. That's smart. Anything else is just you being soft.
cues: Savage mode sauna/heat cue, about every 30 seconds (23)

clips.text: Ohhhhh yeahhhhh! You did it!
cues: end of a completed session (not if ended early)

usage.notes: billable_characters_total is the sum of per-clip billable character counts across all voices. requests counts Speechify requests for packs generated here: 470 for the original two-voice core pack, 284 for john-rhys-davies (235 core + 48 Savage + finish_ohyeah), and 96 for george and harper_32 Savage lines. george and harper_32 finish_ohyeah clips were already live and were not re-synthesized, so they are listed in files/duration/bytes but not added to billable_characters.
